title: Why young protesters are boycotting ‘France’s equivalent of Fox news’

ai.summary: French student protesters are boycotting CNews, a French media outlet, after it criticized their education movement, leading to a petition with over a million signatures demanding its shutdown.

facts.quote: On November 5, as secondary school students gathered in Paris for another day of demonstrations, a journalist associated with French media outlet CNews met an unusually hostile reception. Protesters shouted for him to leave, and police officers reportedly asked the journalist to stop heckling the crowd.

facts.claim: petition with over a million signatures
facts.quote: A petition calling for CNews to be taken off air has gathered more than a million signatures.

ai.background_note: French student protests against education policies have led to media backlash, with protesters targeting CNews for its coverage and a petition demanding its shutdown.
